title: knowltonia major

The Knowltonia plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine and is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of the Knowltonia plant, and it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
